[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk, you remember that day?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You know, the day we set out on[XENO:n ]

No one could have predicted it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It makes me wonder, though...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What if I'd already figured out[XENO:n ]

[XENO:sel sel=・Don't be ridiculous/・Things might have changed ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Even if you'd been able to see[XENO:n ]

what happened to the colony?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I know, I know. But I can't[XENO:n ]
help thinking about it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Think what we could have done if[XENO:n ]
only I'd understood the Monado![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I suppose.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]It could have helped a lot,[XENO:n ]
actually. And not just for us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Homs from all the colonies[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Exactly![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So you see why this is[XENO:n ]

[XENO:sel sel=・Don't dwell on it too much, okay?/・Then I'm just as guilty ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]I know I'm being hard on myself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But...I know what I have to do.[XENO:n ]
And nothing's gonna change that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So don't worry.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]I'm not worried. In fact, I think[XENO:n ]
you're doing a bang up job.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But you've gotta realise that not[XENO:n ]
everything's your fault, man.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]There are some things[XENO:n ]
even you can't fix.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Haha! I'm not that conceited.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I know I can't do everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT24 ]Good to hear![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And at least we had a good reason[XENO:n ]
to come on this big old adventure.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]So that no one else ever has[XENO:n ]
to go through what we did.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]I can't rely on the Monado[XENO:n ]
for everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I have to keep going.[XENO:n ]
Keep fighting![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]That's the spirit, man![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]What is it Dunban likes to say?[XENO:n ]
We've gotta seize our destiny?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Whatever kind of destiny we[XENO:n ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I can't manage that on my own.[XENO:n ]
That's why you'll help me, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Pfft. Alone?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We've got the entire world[XENO:n ]
fighting on our side![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You're right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ][System:PageBreak ]OK! I won't let myself feel[XENO:n ]
down about this anymore.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Everyone's counting[XENO:n ]
on us. Let's go![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Why would you be guilty too, Rein?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I broke a promise I made to Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I couldn't stop you getting hurt.[XENO:n ]
You know, the time you were shot?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

There was nothing you could do.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]No one could have predicted him[XENO:n ]
firing that shot. Not even me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He fooled us all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

You say that, but...[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I still broke a promise.[XENO:n ]
And I'll never forgive myself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Rein...[XENO:n ]
That's not true![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]You've helped me[XENO:n ]
time and time again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So you'll keep watching[XENO:n ]
my back, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Then I won't let you down again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT4 ]'Cos if I do, Fiorung'll[XENO:n ]
knock me for ten![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]Hahaha! You got that right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT24 ][System:PageBreak ]Then I'd better do my best[XENO:n ]
so you don't get scolded, Rein![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]Haha! Then we'll be going round[XENO:n ]
in circles! Sounds like fun though.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I know what happened, happened.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But so many people have gone[XENO:n ]
through so much pain.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I wish I could have[XENO:n ]
prevented it all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I know how you feel,[XENO:n ]
but what's with all the negativity?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]I can't help it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Think of all the people we lost.[XENO:n ]
Too many, if you ask me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:sel sel=・You're not wrong./・Ah, what can you do? ][XENO:del del=all ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]We lost Egil just as we were[XENO:n ]
coming to an understanding.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]But don't you get the feeling it[XENO:n ]
was always gonna be that way?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]He seemed satisfied at the end.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Like he'd done everything[XENO:n ]
he could.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

He gave his all for us.[XENO:n ]
And he gave us hope.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Of course he did![XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]And to think...he had it in for us[XENO:n ]
all, then he went and saved us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]That shocked me almost[XENO:n ]
as much as you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But that's why we can't give up.[XENO:n ]
So Egil's sacrifice wasn't in vain![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT19 ]We're gonna win this one,[XENO:n ]
Shulk. For Egil.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And we won't forget the others[XENO:n ]
who've given their lives.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We'll make them proud![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT21 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]A new future in their name![XENO:n ]
That's our promise to them.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]And that no one will ever have[XENO:n ]
to suffer through this again.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]I'm right with you, Shulk![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]It's not like me to use words like[XENO:n ]
'destiny' and 'fate'.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]But some things are just meant[XENO:n ]
to be. Can't be helped.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah... But that doesn't stop me[XENO:n ]
wishing things had been different.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Shulk...you remember the[XENO:n ]
promise we made that day?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]About destroying all the[XENO:n ]
Mechon and stuff.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yeah, I remember.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And afterwards I realised how[XENO:n ]
wrong we were.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Yeah, me too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]At the time, all I could think about[XENO:n ]
was makin' those Mechon pay.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Turns out we're on the same side.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]We've all lost something or[XENO:n ]
someone worth fighting for.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]Just like Egil.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'm glad we figured that out in the[XENO:n ]
end. We did the right thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]We sure did. And you know[XENO:n ]
what else I think?[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ]I think we should stop making[XENO:n ]
promises we don't intend to keep![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]It definitely couldn't hurt.[XENO:wait wait=key ][System:PageBreak ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Let's do our best, Rein![XENO:n ]
For the future of all life![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
